import subprocess

bulk_input = """# Bulk Al relaxation
units metal
atom_style atomic

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 10000 100000

write_data slab_relaxed.data
""".format(potential=potential_file)

with open(os.path.join(workdir, 'slab.in'), 'w') as f:
    f.write(slab_input)

print("Running slab relaxation...")
subprocess.run(['lmp', '-in', 'slab.in', '-log', 'slab.log'], check=True)
print("Slab relaxation complete.")

print("\nSimulations completed successfully!")
"}</action_input>
